text:
ana: throwing up a small UX thread  goal: improve the heatmap scrubber + p95 hover flows so users can keyboard-navigate, pin buckets for side-by-side compare, and clearly see when values come from sampling vs full dataset

mike: sounds good. two quick asks: 1) scrubber should show live tooltip with exact bucket timestamp + p95, 2) support Shift+Arrow to expand selection range for quick zoom :keyboard:

sara: a11y first: tooltip must be reachable via keyboard (Enter/Space to open) and we need `aria-describedby` text describing sampled vs exact. when sampled, readout should say "estimated p95 based on N samples" so screen-reader users know the caveat

lex: pin-to-compare idea  let users press `p` on a focused bucket to pin it. pinned items show as small chips above the chart and can be selected for pairwise comparison in the right-side panel. chips should include time, p95 and a small sampled badge if applicable

kevin: engineering constraints: keep pin action client-only (store in local state) and only fetch full traces on explicit "Open traces" click to avoid autosampling churn. telemetry: `bucket_pinned` event + `comparison_requested`

olivia: copy micro-nit: when sampled, microcopy should read "p95 (estimated, based on N samples)" not just "estimated"  clearer for non-technical PMs. also suggest a small info icon that opens a one-line explanation rather than a modal

ana: tiny correction, it's "ana" above :) UX question: should timezone anchoring be sticky in the header? proposal: sticky header shows `Timezone: <user pref>` and a small toggle that applies immediately instead of reloading the page

mike: yes to sticky timezone. default to UTC, but sticky toggle to local when changed. make sure the scrubber tooltip displays timezone label (e.g., "2025-08-09 14:23 PDT")

sara: color/contrast: sampled badge must have both color + icon to help color-blind users. ensure badge text meets 3:1 and the badge has an accessible name `aria-label="Sampled data flag"`

lex: interaction detail: pinned chips should persist per-tab (not global) and have keyboard-focus order. keyboard flow: Tab to heatmap, Arrow keys to move bucket, `p` to pin, Shift+Tab to move to pinned list

kevin: debounce sampling fetches while scrubbing at 250ms. if user holds arrow keys, fetch only after they pause. also cap preview samples to 5 per request and mark as `est` in response schema

ux-bot: design preview uploaded: https://staging-console.redwood-inference.com/scrubber-pin-preview (expires in 72h) :spiral_calendar:

olivia: small accessibility test case: screen-reader should announce "Pinned 14:23 PDT, p95 estimated 240ms" when pinning a sampled bucket. add that to acceptance criteria

ana: acceptance checklist I'll add to the ticket: 1) keyboard flows & shortcuts doc, 2) aria-describedby text for sampled tooltip, 3) sampled badge + icon with contrast test, 4) pin persistence (tab-scoped), 5) debounce + cap for preview fetches, 6) sticky timezone toggle in header

mike: copy tweak for tooltip header: use "p95 (est.)" shorthand only when space constrained; prefer full "p95 (estimated)" in most places. also prefer `Pin` label over `Save`

ana: thanks all  I'll update Figma and create the PR for acceptance criteria. will post mocks and keyboard walkthrough video in this thread once ready :thumbsup:
